title: Renewable Elder Guardians
description: Vanilla friendly mod and plugin port that makes Elder Guardians (and sponge) renewable, while keeping it balanced.
body:
Sponge is now renewable! And so are elder guardians!!

## Features
- Use a nautilus shell on a guardian (either left or right hand) to transform it into an Elder Guardian!
  
## Planned Improvements
- More immersive transformation process, like a zombie villager cure maybe.
